rule: Returns must be requested within 30 days of the recorded delivery date. Any return request past 30 days must be strictly rejected by the system. Opened skincare products with >50% remaining are accepted.
Items marked as 'Final Sale', 'Archive Sale', or hygiene-sealed sample kits are strictly non-refundable and non-returnable. No exceptions may be authorized by automated agents.

Orders can only be modified or cancelled while in 'PROCESSING' status within 2 hours of placement. Once an order moves to 'IN_TRANSIT' or 'SHIPPED', the address cannot be altered by the merchant and cancellation is impossible; customer must initiate a return after delivery.
A prepaid return shipping label is provided upon return authorization. A flat $5.00 return processing deduction applies unless the return is due to damaged goods or an incorrect item sent.

If a package shows no tracking scan update for 5 consecutive business days, the agent may initiate a carrier tracer or offer a free priority replacement. Packages currently out for delivery cannot be declared lost.
